title: channel.py: OverflowError if epoch is negative or exceeds 32 bits
description: Line 146: `epoch.to_bytes(4, 'little')` raises OverflowError for negative epoch or epoch > 0xFFFFFFFF. Same pattern as seed bug - sfn is masked on same line but epoch is not. Parameter has no documented bounds and no validation.
close_reason: epoch.to_bytes now masks with & 0xFFFFFFFF (same u32 wrap as sfn). Tests: test_epoch_wraps_as_u32 against independent FNV-1a oracle. pytest tests/link/test_channel.py 33 passed.
